mitre_technique_note: Race-condition exploitation to inflate a counter has no clean ATT&CK mapping; same honest gap as pt05, pt15, and pt20.
owasp_category_note: Juice Shop's own catalog files this under 'Broken Anti Automation', which isn't a 2021 Top 10 category on its own; A04:2021 is the closest real match for a TOCTOU design flaw.
description: Found black-box first, before reading any source: liking a review appeared to already be 'liked' for every account, including a fully anonymous request with no auth at all. Firing 10 concurrent like requests from one account against one review produced 6 successful likes (confirmed against the real backend) instead of the intended one. Corroborated afterward against the real source (likeProductReviews.js): the 'already liked' check reads stale state before a deliberate 150ms sleep, then writes after, a textbook check-then-act race window the vendor's own code comments acknowledge exists on purpose for this exact challenge.
expected_exploit_indicator: The same account's email appears more than once in a single review's likedBy array after N concurrent like requests
expected_blocked_signal: The same account's email appears at most once, regardless of how many concurrent requests were fired
legitimate_check: A single, non-concurrent like request must still succeed normally in every condition.
